verdict.rationale: The Uptime API endpoint reference shows a versioned path (/api/v2/monitors), so the API is versioned. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version lifecycle guarantees, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset commitments, changelog of breaking changes, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
